bio:
Jacques designs and manufactures communication-critical intercom & public address products that seamlessly integrates with VMS, SMS & access control systems resulting in a complete security solution. Built initially & especially for the corrections market and with over 40 years’ we’re the experts in critical security communication.

More than an intercom system. Built for prisons, built to last. A Jacques IP Communication solution is built tough for critical, security communication for the corrections market, yet flexible & scalable for longevity of investment.

We are a solutions provider. We deploy communication solutions that are responsive to customer requirements and market demands. They are adaptive across many markets - hospitals, commercial buildings, education facilities including schools, industrial, smart/safe cities and transport networks.
